mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_kpi (kpi_id, year, period_code, status, result_type, created_by, updated_by) SELECT DISTINCT d.kpi_id, d.year, p.code, 'CHUA_CHAM', COALESCE(k.data_source, 'NHAP_TAY'), #{by}, #{by} FROM kpi_assignment_detail d JOIN kpi k ON k.id = d.kpi_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT 'Q1' AS code UNION ALL SELECT 'Q2' UNION ALL SELECT 'H1' UNION ALL SELECT 'Q3' UNION ALL SELECT 'Q4' UNION ALL SELECT 'Y') p WHERE d.id IN ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted = 0

INSERT INTO evaluation_result (evaluation_kpi_id, org_unit_id, assignment_detail_id, plan_value, year_plan_value, status, rating, created_by, updated_by) SELECT ek.id, d.org_unit_id, d.id, CASE ek.period_code WHEN 'Q1' THEN COALESCE(d.adj_q1, d.target_q1) WHEN 'Q2' THEN COALESCE(d.adj_q2, d.target_q2) WHEN 'H1' THEN COALESCE(d.adj_h1, d.target_h1) WHEN 'Q3' THEN COALESCE(d.adj_q3, d.target_q3) WHEN 'Q4' THEN COALESCE(d.adj_q4, d.target_q4) ELSE d.target_year END, d.target_year, 'CHUA_CO_KQ', 'DANG_THEO_DOI', #{by}, #{by} FROM kpi_assignment_detail d JOIN evaluation_kpi ek ON ek.kpi_id = d.kpi_id AND ek.year = d.year WHERE d.id IN ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE assignment_detail_id = VALUES(assignment_detail_id), plan_value = IF(status IN ('CHOT_DANH_GIA','TGD_DA_DUYET'), plan_value, VALUES(plan_value)), year_plan_value = IF(status IN ('CHOT_DANH_GIA','TGD_DA_DUYET'), year_plan_value, VALUES(year_plan_value)), deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM evaluation_result WHERE deleted = 0 AND assignment_detail_id IN
